    1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
    2: """
    3: Session 31A — I-1: Instanton-Kapitza Frequency Ratio
    4: 
    5: Computes the instanton tunneling rate Gamma_inst(tau) and compares it
    6: to the modulus rolling frequency omega_tau = sqrt(|d^2V/dtau^2|).
    7: 
    8: The instanton action on Jensen-deformed SU(3):
    9:   S_inst(tau) = alpha_grav * (-R(tau)) + alpha_YM * K(tau)
   10: 
   11: where R(tau) is the scalar curvature and K(tau) is the Kretschner scalar
   12: (exact analytic formulas from Permanent Results Registry Section III).
   13: 
   14: The tunneling rate:
   15:   Gamma_inst(tau) ~ exp(-S_inst(tau))
   16: 
   17: Gate I-1: PASS if Gamma_inst/omega_tau > 3 at some tau in [0.05, 0.55]
   18:           for any coupling ratio alpha_YM/alpha_grav.
   19: 
   20: Inputs:
   21:   - Analytic curvature formulas (R, K from Session 17b)
   22:   - s30b_grid_bcs.npz (V_total for omega_tau)
   23: 
   24: Outputs:
   25:   - s31a_instanton_kapitza.npz
   26:   - s31a_instanton_kapitza.png
   27: 
   28: Author: phonon-exflation-sim agent (Session 31A)
   29: Date: 2026-03-02
   30: """

   11: 
   12: Gate K-1: PASS if V_Kapitza has interior minimum at tau_* in (0.05, 0.55)
   13:           for ANY amplitude A with d^2 V_Kapitza / dtau^2 > 0.
   14: 
   15: Inputs:
   16:   - s30b_grid_bcs.npz  (V_total on 21x21 grid)
   17:   - s30b_5d_stability.npz  (T3/T4 eigenvalues for omega_perp)

   19:

   25: Date: 2026-03-02
   26: """
